purpose: All original 267 OpenSees planning rows reviewed for represent/execute/query/edit capability before Bench authoring. Exact source snapshot includes all task and model fields.
method: Read original model spec/property/boundary/load/challenge and task scenario/output/analysis contract, not the keyword coverage projection.
Map exact family + dimension and manually reviewed feature memberships to concrete implementation and independent capability recipes.

Feature-set equality groups reusable requirement combinations, not independently executed tests. The 12 mechanics recipes plus prior focused tests validate component interactions; each row also has explicit source-specific representability reasoning. Different geometry/load/property values remain distinct future Bench models.
Use shared input/state/query evidence separately from mechanics. Do not claim an uncreated image or full 267-case execution was tested.

first-order-linear-static.meaning: Explicit self-weight OFF; no invented floor, rigid offset, P-Delta or automatic combination.

arbitrary-endpoint-topology.meaning: Explicit stable node IDs and member endpoints preserve setbacks, omitted members, variable elevations and continuous connections.

per-object-elastic-properties.meaning: Independent material E/G and member A/Iy/Iz/J in one canonical record; no forced common section or stiffness.

signed-node-response-and-reactions.meaning: All applicable global displacement/rotation components and signed support reactions retain node IDs.

frame-2d.meaning: Canonical XZ elastic beam/column assembly and My/Ry signs.

frame-3d.meaning: Spatial elastic beam/column axial, biaxial bending and finite torsion.

truss-2d.meaning: Only axial stiffness in 2D with explicit end connectivity.

truss-3d.meaning: Only axial stiffness in space with explicit translational restraints.

partial-or-disjoint-member-loads.meaning: Preserve separate load objects and true load intervals in solver segmentation.

independent-piecewise-section-material-b.meaning: Use distinct constant-property physical members with common continuous interface nodes; not a tapered element or hinge.

global-nodal-or-member-moment.meaning: Actual nodal moment, or member point moment at a solver node, in global signed components.

case-and-combination-sets.meaning: Independent cases and explicitly factored combinations are each solved and saved, never substituted with unrelated envelopes.

inclined-member-global-load-real-length.meaning: Global line load transformed once to member axes over actual 3D/2D member length.

principal-axes-and-coordinate-frame.meaning: Explicit 90-degree principal rotation and spatial reference vector; asymmetric Iy/Iz are preserved.

proper-source-basis-transformation.meaning: Reviewed inputs transform coordinates, vectors, moments and directional restraints consistently before canonical execution.

finite-elastic-branch-not-rigid-offset.meaning: Short arms and transfer/hanging members are ordinary finite EA/EI/GJ elements at actual endpoints.

explicit-crossing-connectivity.meaning: Crossings join only via a declared common endpoint. No auto-welding from coordinates.

mixed-frame-and-axial-only-braces.meaning: Shared translations and frame rotations; free rotations at truss-only nodes are excluded from stiffness.

explicit-line-load-tributary-conversion-.meaning: Store the reviewed product q_area*width as the specified line load; retain provenance, do not also apply a floor load.

internal-observation-and-sided-cuts.meaning: A connected observation node or load-inclusive analytic recovery at exact physical member positions; point force/moment sides remain distinct.

support-only-freedoms-and-internal-guide.meaning: Explicit per-node active DOF masks including pin, roller, internal lateral guide and axial freedom. This does not require generic beam-end releases.

explicit-units-no-magnitude-guess.meaning: Per-field source units resolve into canonical m/kN/MPa/m2/m4. Output conversion leaves the physical model unchanged.

selective-undo-preserving-later-independ.meaning: Reverse only the chosen transaction; retain later non-conflicting fields and reject actual field/reference conflicts.

undo-latest-stable-object-history.meaning: Restore the selected latest independent edit with new model revision and preserve history.

output-only-change-with-current-run-reus.meaning: A requested observation or unit change does not alter the physical model or introduce new loads.

multistep-targeted-model-edit.meaning: Stable object-level atomic edits preserve all unspecified topology, properties and loads; each new state invalidates stale current results.

draft-missing-information-or-conflict.meaning: Missing required information/contradictory sources remain a draft; explicit correction precedes calculation.

reviewed-attachment-association.meaning: Associate reviewed image/table labels and source regions with canonical fields; do not treat uncreated attachments as recognized.

multi-view-three-dimensional-reconstruct.meaning: Multi-view reviewed geometry must resolve actual connections and axes before submitting one canonical 3D model.

dxf-structure-entities-and-layer-filteri.meaning: DXF parsing preserves transformed entities/layers; reviewed structural selection determines members rather than all architectural lines.

ops-planned-recipes.scope: 12 actual OpenSees parametrized tests; independent virtual-work, force-method and bar-energy references; capability recipes, not 267 answers.

ops-mesh.scope: Actual OpenSees full/partial/point/piecewise member loads, explicit G, 2D/3D rotated axes, pure/mixed trusses and input rejection.

ops-coordinate.scope: Real OpenSees 2D/3D global-coordinate and signed-force contract; inclined global load resultants.

coordinate-guard.scope: Explicit dimension, forbidden out-of-plane loads, orthonormal axes and nodal/member frame distinctions.

canonical-properties.scope: Canonical E/G/A/I/J preservation, property-only section records, geometry conflicts.

state-and-undo.scope: Shared model identity, atomic edits, revision/run invalidation, latest/selected undo with independent subsequent edits, stable-ID reordering and actual field/reference conflict protection.

field-units.scope: Per-field unit conversion, stable object identification and conflict handling.

reviewed-input-evidence.scope: Reviewed image regions/table fields and conflict/missing-input draft gates; not recognition accuracy of uncreated Bench attachments.

dxf-parser.scope: Three actual ezdxf parser regressions: transformed block/line provenance, dimension-graphics exclusion, unsupported entities and truncation explicitly reported.

actual-public-scenario.scope: Real OpenSees run through normalized service and public edit/undo/query: point-couple left/right cuts, exact internal displacement, node difference, controlling combination and undo preserving later Iy edit.

internal-query.scope: Verified load-inclusive internal displacement and force recovery, physical member mapping and left/right point-force cuts.

run-delivery.scope: Specified position/component/unit/selection and immutable archived run delivery. Shared quantity units and source selection; real public tool receipt is separately registered.

referenceMethods: Exact Euler-Bernoulli virtual-work energy of branched frame with independent per-member E/G/A/I/J.
Two-redundant force method and exact polynomial integration for continuous variable-property beam.
Independent sum of axial-bar energy matrices for nonuniform spatial truss and connected/nonconnected crossings.
Closed-form guided and internally propped columns; frame flexibility plus rank-one spatial brace stiffness.
mechanics.tolerance: Test references/tolerances defined before candidate execution; no historical Bench values or tolerances modified.

checks: Point couple x=2 left M2=20, right M2=0 kN.m
Node difference and controlling combination -15 mm
Undo selected load transaction preserves later doubled Iy; recalculated tip uz=-0.005 m
